dataset: Daily_Ports_Data - daily port calls and trade estimates by port
requested_scope: 2025 full year for port514 Tanjung Priok, port1237 Surabaya, port1179 Semarang; then 2020-2024; then 2026 year-to-date; then other Indonesian container ports
actual_scope: 2025 full year for all 101 IDN ports in the service (36,865 records); 2025, 2020-2024 and 2026-01-01..11-20 for the three priority ports (7,548 records); layer metadata, service catalogue and port reference
notes: Provider-native JSON pages, 1,000 records per page, paged on resultOffset with orderByFields=portid,date. IDN-wide 2020-2024 (184,527 records) and IDN-wide 2026 YTD were deferred_budget. Service returns 2026 data through 2026-11-20 as observed.

dataset: Container Port Performance Index - editions, methodology and comparative annex
requested_scope: 2020-2025 editions and the comparative annex, with methodology and report PDFs
actual_scope: CPPI 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023 edition report PDFs; 2023 guidance note; methodology note; the 2020-2025 comparative annex document (resolved by document id only)
notes: The document-detail page capture is quarantined in _local_only/worldbank-cppi/ because it embeds the publisher's client-side ApiKey; the annex PDF itself is in data/raw/. Edition PDF URLs were resolved through the documented WDS search API (search.worldbank.org/api/v2/wds). The CPPI 2024 and 2025 editions are not present in that index, so they are deferred. Underlying carrier call records are not public and are not assumed.

dataset: Statistik Transportasi Laut - annual publications and the major-port cargo statistics table
requested_scope: Official annual publications 2025 then 2020-2024, plus the downloadable major-port table
actual_scope: Statistik Transportasi Laut publication PDFs for data years 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024; the 'Bongkar/Muat Barang Angkutan Laut Luar Negeri di 4 Pelabuhan Utama' statistics-table page as published
notes: BPS serves publication PDFs behind a one-time webapi.bps.go.id/download.php token; the token is never recorded in the manifest. The publication listing page is a JavaScript app with no static index, so editions were reached from the related-publications block. The captured 2024 landing page embeds live tokens and is quarantined in _local_only/.

dataset: Jumlah Bongkar Muat pada Pelabuhan Utama Petikemas (Data Prioritas 2025, identifier dp25_12)
requested_scope: Follow the catalog resource links to the provider's native spreadsheet/API; catalog-only if the files are unreachable
actual_scope: Provider-native XLSX and JSON resource files (years 2020-2025 as published), the Satu Data catalog page and the hubnet dataset page
notes: The resource endpoint was read from the catalog page's embedded package JSON: hubnet.kemenhub.go.id/dataset/get-data-api/microstrategy/dp_jumlah_bongkar_muat_pada_pelabuhan_utama_petikemas?&format=excel|json. hubnet.kemenhub.go.id/terms timed out, so no licence statement was captured.

dataset: Quarterly Port Liner Shipping Connectivity Index
requested_scope: Quarterly PLSCI export plus published definitions
actual_scope: Landing/theme page, the UNCTADstat data-centre report page for US.PortLSCI, and the site config listing its API hosts
notes: No documented native export route exists. The data centre is a single-page app; /EN/BulkDownload.html returns 404; the datamart API requires an undocumented path parameter; tableViewer and reportFolders both 302 to the SPA shell. The rendered table was deliberately not scraped into a local table. Deferred.

dataset: Non-oil exports by loading port and imports by unloading port
requested_scope: Native exports and footnotes, or public HTML where no export exists, with export and import directions kept separate
actual_scope: Both published HTML tables (2021-2025, with 2026 year-to-date where shown) were captured byte-for-byte but are held in _local_only/kemendag/, not in the tracked area
notes: These pages publish no file export, so the native HTML page is the source-native form of the data. The captures are quarantined because the site's shared page chrome embeds six JWT-shaped signed support-ticket links; the table data itself carries no secret. Publishing it needs a decision from the owner (see deferred.md item 13). Export and import directions are kept apart and were never joined.

dataset: Published facilities, capacity and operating information
requested_scope: Facility/operations data and linked official releases on berths, equipment, activity and annual throughput
actual_scope: Facilities and operations page (berthing contract, delivery, receiving, loading operations), about and home pages
notes: No annual throughput series and no annual report is published: the publication page renders 'Belum ada publikasi'. Transactional pages (tracking, e-billing, e-do) were not touched. Deferred for any official release carrying throughput.

provider: PT Pelabuhan Indonesia (Persero) and PT Pelindo Terminal Petikemas
dataset: Annual, sustainability, financial and quarterly reports
requested_scope: 2025 first, then other years, keeping entity and consolidation level per file
actual_scope: Pelindo parent: annual reports 2024 and 2025, sustainability reports 2024 and 2025, consolidated group level. Pelindo Terminal Petikemas: annual reports 2024 and 2025, sustainability reports 2024 and 2025, 2025 financial statements, plus the investor-report index
notes: pelindo.id/investor/laporan-tahunan returns HTTP 403 (bot challenge) so pelindo.co.id/download/... static asset links were used instead. The parent financial-statement index and the quarterly management report were deferred_budget.

dataset: Container and non-coal freight press releases, rail-port access
requested_scope: Publicly listed freight statistics, reports and relevant official releases
actual_scope: Five official press releases (the register-linked one plus four 2026 container/freight releases)
notes: Narrative-only releases, kept as references. /publikasi/siaran-pers has no keyword filter and api.kai.id/msvc-webcorp/press-release returns 404, so discovery was bounded to page scans rather than a crawl. No structured freight statistics file is published.

dataset: Patimban Port development phase III - planning and progress documents
requested_scope: Development, planning, progress and commissioning documents, projected and observed files kept separate
actual_scope: The register-linked JICA press release (narrative only)
notes: The release links no PDF or data file and no relevant Kemenhub statistics page, so nothing enters data/raw/. There is no projected/observed file pair to separate. Deferred pending a JICA project document or Kemenhub operational release.

dataset: Indonesia and Java extracts, snapshot metadata and licence
requested_scope: Native single-region downloads for Jakarta/West Java or compact port-corridor extracts; index larger archives rather than downloading them
actual_scope: Indonesia index page and the native md5 of indonesia-latest.osm.pbf (958156b0447005ea6080acff68b6b6d6), the Java sub-region listing, the ODbL 1.0 text and the Geofabrik legal notice
notes: deferred_size: indonesia-latest.osm.pbf is ~1.6 GB and java-latest.osm.pbf is 899,757,620 bytes, both far above the 90 MB per-file cap; dated Java files are 704-858 MB and the shapefile/GPKG variants 1.8-2.2 GB. Geofabrik publishes no Jakarta-level extract. No routing, cropping or GIS processing was run.

dataset: ERA5 hourly single-level reanalysis time series
requested_scope: Native hourly exports of 10 m U/V wind and precipitation at verified port points, monthly chunks
actual_scope: The dataset landing page and a written record of the blocker
notes: The page states 'Free access upon acceptance of applicable licences and terms of use' and requires a CDS API key from the user's profile. No account was created, no licence accepted, no token used, and no api call was attempted. Deferred pending the user's own CDS credentials.

dataset: Kolinamil (Jakarta Port) tide-gauge station metadata and 2025 water level observations
requested_scope: Station catalog metadata and the case-year high-frequency or archived observations available for the station
actual_scope: Station metadata for koli (catalog SSC-koli, -6.10667/106.89083, UTCOffset 0, WMO SZID52) and four 10-day 2025 observation windows (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct), 11,570-14,323 records each
notes: The documented v1 API is used; v2 needs an API key. The documented 30-day window exceeded the 120 s request ceiling (~24 KB/s) and the partial file was discarded. No datum field is published, so none is inferred. Deferred: full-year 2025 coverage in 10-day windows.

dataset: Hourly point meteorology and solar irradiance for verified comparator port points
requested_scope: Solar irradiance and relevant native met variables for verified port points in manageable date windows
actual_scope: Full 2025 calendar year, 8,760 hourly values per parameter, for port514 Tanjung Priok, port1237 Surabaya and port1179 Semarang: ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, T2M, WS10M, WD10M, PRECTOTCORR, RH2M
notes: Coordinates come from the provider's own PortWatch ports layer attributes (lat/long), recorded with an audit note, so no reprojection or geocoding was involved. No PV yield or emissions figure was derived.

dataset: National grid emission factor table, 2019 vintage
requested_scope: Public factor vintages, preserving vintage and geography
actual_scope: The 2019 factor PDF as published (246,196 bytes)
notes: Factors are kept exactly as published; no conversion or emissions estimate was made.

dataset: Shore power technology assessment at US ports
actual_scope: The assessment PDF (via the linked nepis.epa.gov record) and the programme page as published
notes: US federal government work, recorded as public_redistribution_ok. Reference material for method only, not Indonesian port data.

dataset: JISDOR USD/IDR reference rate, workday series
requested_scope: Native workday USD/IDR series for 2025, then 2020-2024, keeping provider field labels and date conventions
actual_scope: Raw DataSet XML for 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 (237-248 workdays per year) plus the JISDOR page, ASMX service page and WSDL
notes: The real operation names are getSubKursJisdor1..4; getSubKursJisdor3(mts,startDate,endDate) returned the series over the documented HTTP GET binding. A SOAP POST was rejected by a WAF ('Akses Ditolak'), and the page's own Download button is an ASP.NET postback that was deliberately not submitted.

requested_scope: Permitted cargo vessel-presence responses for small documented port geometries and date windows
actual_scope: The report API documentation, authentication and licence/rate-limit pages
notes: Every request needs a personal Bearer token from an account, which was not created. The terms are noncommercial-only under CC BY-NC 4.0 with mandatory attribution, which also blocks inclusion in a redistributable folder. These are AIS vessel-presence estimates, not terminal attendance logs.

dataset: IOE 2027 brief and terminal-level records (berth, pilot, tug, work order, yard, gate, meter, injury, contract, tariff)
requested_scope: The case brief and any terminal records the user explicitly provides with permitted access
actual_scope: Nothing: the workspace holds the collection prompt, not the IOE 2027 brief itself, and no terminal records were supplied
notes: No public comparator data can substitute for terminal-level records. No operator was contacted and no non-public endpoint was probed. The brief, if supplied later, is local_only unless the user authorises publication.
